title: What the Giant Otter calls out

is_this_you.pressure: Something moves in the reeds and your voice is out before your reasons. By the time you check, the family is at your shoulder.
is_this_you.love: You love out loud. Whoever answers your call without asking why keeps you.
is_this_you.cost: You guard so hard that some of the ones you love swim off to a calmer pool, and never tell you why.

opener.text: Around 100 CE the Shuowen Jiezi, the oldest Chinese dictionary, defined the otter, 獭 (tǎ), as 如小狗也 (rú xiǎo gǒu yě), “like a small dog,” a creature that lives in water and eats fish [s17]. The character still carries the dog radical on its left side [s17]. You were born an Aries in a Dog year. The Dog was in your animal's name all along. It just went for a swim.

tabs.label: The watch
tabs.intro: Fire that starts it. Earth that holds the bank.

rows.text: Aries is cardinal Fire, ruled by Mars, the first sign [s1] [s2]. The Dog is yang Earth, loyal, honest and protective [s3] [s4] [s5]. Your Fire goes straight into the Dog's watch. You notice first, and you say it for everyone.

rows.k: The giant otter does it too
rows.text: Giant otters live in family groups, and the adults use 22 kinds of call, each tied to its own main job [s7] [s10]. When a predator comes near, several call at once in a chorus [s8]. Researchers could tell family groups apart by the sound of that chorus [s8]. Your family has a sound too. You would know it across a whole river, and hear who is missing from it.

tabs.label: Your pack
tabs.intro: Three who answer your call. One who argues back.
tabs.love_lead: Love, for you, is a call and an answer. Aries falls hard and fast [s1] [s2], and the Dog stays once it trusts. You need someone who answers your whistle without asking why, and who can show you that a still evening is safe. The old pairings send three.

tabs.label: Who you would fight for
tabs.intro: Alone you are careful. With a pup behind you, less so.

rows.text: In one recorded encounter, four adult giant otters drove off a black caiman about 4.5 metres long [s12]. BBC Wildlife filmed a family with six cubs fighting a black caiman for nearly an hour, and the otters won [s13]. You rarely start a fight for yourself. Over your own people, you never walk away from one.

Mencius wrote that the one who drives the fish into the deep pool is the otter: 为渊驱鱼者，獭也 (wèi yuān qū yú zhě, tǎ yě) [s17]. He meant harsh rulers who push their people toward a kinder lord [s17]. Guard too loudly and the ones you love look for calmer water. Wait a day before you call everyone in.
Emergency medicine, search and rescue and lifeguarding all reward the one who sees trouble first and shouts.

easy.why: The Golden Pheasant (Leo, Rabbit year) is your secret friend, since the Rabbit is the Dog's hidden ally, and Leo is Fire like you [s3] [s1].
The Lanner Falcon (Sagittarius, Tiger year) shares your trine of Tiger, Horse and Dog, and Sagittarius burns with the same Fire [s3] [s1].
The Paradise Riflebird (Leo, Horse year) closes the trine, and the Horse's Fire warms your Dog's Earth [s3] [s4].

hard.why: The one who argues back is the Giant Manta Ray (Libra, Dragon year): the Dragon clashes with the Dog, and Libra sits opposite Aries [s3] [s1].

story.text: In Irish, the otter's everyday names are dog names: madra uisce, “water dog,” and dobharchú, “water hound” [s19]. They belong to the Eurasian otter of Irish rivers [s18]. Two languages half a world apart looked at an otter and saw a dog.

closing: Call once, as loud as you like. They will come, because you always came for them.
